sources.barDiameters: NBR 7480: the nominal bar diameters (CA-60 wire Ø5, Ø6.3; CA-50 Ø6.3-Ø40); the sets by use are SAEngine practice (NBR 6118 18.4.2.1: column bars at least Ø10; 18.3.3.2: stirrups at least Ø5)
sources.barNames: Brazilian practice: Ø + the diameter with the decimal comma
sources.modulus: NBR 6118:2014 8.2.8: Ecs = αi Eci, Eci = 5600 √fck (granite αE 1.0), αi = 0.8 + 0.2 fck/80: taken as 0.85 × 5600 √fck = 4760 √fck for the analysis (1.5 % below αi Eci at C25, 3 % at C30, 6 % at C40; SAEngine practice, the stiffer modulus of higher grades not taken)
